keyFindings.strictReality: Under the STRICTEST rule (counting all 30 MLB teams' Spring Training starting Feb 19 AND NFL Playoffs through Super Bowl Feb 14), there is NO continuous 14-day or 21-day zero-game window in 2027, 2028, or 2029 because the gap between the Super Bowl and MLB Spring Training is only 4–7 days.
keyFindings.best2027Strict: Feb 15–18, 2027 (4 consecutive 100% zero-game days, VERIFIED) and Feb 1–18, 2027 (18-day stretch containing ONLY Pro Bowl Games + Super Bowl LXI — 16 zero-game days!).
keyFindings.best2027NoSpring: Feb 15 – Mar 23, 2027 = 37 CONSECUTIVE DAYS (5+ WEEKS, VERIFIED!) completely free of MLB Regular Season, NFL, Stanford/Cal NCAAF, and Westwood One NFL!
keyFindings.best2028NoSpring: Feb 14 – Mar 22, 2028 = ~38 CONSECUTIVE DAYS (5+ WEEKS, ESTIMATED pending 2028 MLB & Super Bowl LXII confirmation).
keyFindings.best2029NoSpring: Feb 12 – Mar 28, 2029 = ~45 CONSECUTIVE DAYS (6+ WEEKS, ESTIMATED pending 2029 schedules).
keyFindings.midSummerAlert: MLB All-Star Break yields 1 full zero-game Wednesday (Jul 14, 2027 VERIFIED; Jul 12, 2028 EST; Jul 11, 2029 EST). Watch July 2028 closely: Oracle Park hosts the 2028 All-Star Game alongside the 2028 LA Summer Olympics!
